subject: Request: credentialed nodes sponsorship for shielded VPC trial
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Donnelly <mike.donnelly@exacloud.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers on your private offering look promising for our clinical summarization workload. Before we sign the pilot MSA, our security team needs a path for a shielded evaluation inside our VPC with credentialed nodes (isolated GPUs, customer-managed KMS). Two asks from our side: 

1) Sponsored infra credits to cover an initial 30-day evaluation (estimate: ~450 GPU-hours, plus token/embedding usage).
2) A short checklist of security evidence we can hand to procurement (SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, and a short attestation about KMS and key custody).

Can Redwood provide a scoped sponsorship + the evidence bundle? Procurement timeline is tight — CFO wants cost projection by next Friday.

Appreciate the help.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Senior Director, Integrations
ExaHealth
[Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Hi Alice — great to meet you.

We can absolutely support a shielded VPC pilot with credentialed nodes. Quick summary of what we can offer: 
- Sponsored compute credit: up to 500 GPU-hours (NVIDIA A40 equiv) and $5k in token/embedding usage credit for the initial 30 days.
- Security evidence bundle: SOC2 snapshot, network diagram for the VPC peering setup, and a one-page KMS custody note.
- Timeline: we can provision the isolated nodes after a short onboarding call and a signed one-page sponsorship agreement.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kar to confirm technical checklist and required connectivity.
2) Share a sponsorship draft for legal/procurement to review (I’ll attach a template).
3) Quick onboarding call to map out static IPs, KMS ARNs, and audit-log retention.

I’ve looped in Kar (SE) for the technical checklist and Dev (Ops lead) for provisioning SLAs.

If that sounds OK, I’ll route the sponsorship draft and we can target provisioning the week of May 25.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference
Office: +1 415-555-0124
[Attachment: sponsored-credit-agreement-draft.docx]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Hi team — quick technical notes from the SE side: 

1) Credentialed nodes: we’ll provision a small reserved pool behind a customer-facing NAT with VPC peering and strict security groups. We support customer-managed KMS — please share the ARN and key policy we should expect.

2) Evidence bundle we can provide immediately: SOC2 snapshot (last 12 months), VPC network diagram (we will overlay Redwood's side), and an audit-log sample (redacted). I attached the latest SOC2 extract we can share.

3) Resource sizing: 450 GPU-hours estimate seems right for your pilot signal test. If you run peak inference bursts, request burst capacity and let us know the expected qps.

4) On provisioning: Dev will need a signed sponsorship sheet and confirmation of IP CIDR ranges to whitelist.

Attaching: SOC2_snapshot.pdf, vpc_network_diagram.pdf (draft).

— Kar
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
[Attachment: SOC2_snapshot.pdf]
[Attachment: vpc_network_diagram.pdf]

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Donnelly <mike.donnelly@exacloud.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Thanks Kar — that list helps. Procurement has two small asks: 
1) SOC2 extract must include the control IDs for change management and access controls (we’ve attached a short template).
2) Procurement needs the pilot sponsorship drafted as a one-page letter with credit caps and liability limits. Can legal at Redwood sign a lightweight MOU?

If you can get the SOC2 extract with highlighted control IDs and the one-page sponsorship by Wednesday, our procurement can approve the purchase order and sign the onboarding. We should be able to stand up the peering in 48 hours after that.

— Alice
[Attachment: procurement_soc2_template.docx]

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Vanessa / Kar — I reviewed the ask and we can approve a targeted sponsorship under the following guardrails: 

- Sponsorship: 500 GPU-hours + $5k token credits, valid for 30 calendar days from provisioning.
- Security evidence: provide SOC2 extract with highlighted control IDs + network diagram + KMS note.
- Operational limits: max parallel worker count = 8; audit logs retained for 90 days.
- Liability: limited to trial credits; full MSA still required for production.

I’ve pre-approved the provisioning SLA: we’ll commit to a 72-hour turnaround from signed sponsorship to nodes online (assuming CIDR and KMS details are provided).

Vanessa — please confirm and send the signable one-page sponsorship (I’ll BCC legal on the final).

— Dev
Dev Patel
Head of Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.inference
[Attachment: none]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@exahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ask: credentialed nodes + credits for shielded VPC evaluation

Alice — thanks, we’re aligned. I attached the one-page sponsorship and highlighted the credit caps and the security deliverables. Next steps: 
1) You confirm CIDR ranges and the KMS ARN this afternoon.
2) Sign the one-page sponsorship (DocuSign link included below).
3) We provision and target go-live within 72 hours of signature.

Links: DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/23A4B2-sponsorship-draft — I’ll route to Legal as soon as you sign.

If procurement needs a billing contact for a purchase order instead of DocuSign, loop me and I’ll provide the correct PO email (billing@redwood.inference).

Looking forward to getting you started.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference
Office: +1 415-555-0124
[Attachment: sponsored-credit-agreement-draft.docx]
